## Background

ClimateAi applies AI to climate risk modeling, providing short- and long-term insights into weather and climate impacts to help businesses identify the actions needed today to adapt to the climate disruptions of tomorrow.

## What I Did

-   Improved short-term forecasts of mean temperature & precipitation by 20% over the best vendor's model ([more on this project](../../research/weather-meta-model/index.qmd))
-   Designed a multi-model ensemble algorithm combining 6 data sources, with different weights across 30 customer locations & 4 lead times
-   Built automated back-end pipelines in Google Cloud for geospatial data extraction, preprocessing, and forecast skill & uncertainty analysis, updating model weights weekly using Xarray & pandas
-   Presented Tableau map visualizations comparing our improved model's performance with competitors'
